title: A Bayesian Longitudinal Spatial Normative Model for Individualized Brain Deviation Mapping
summary: Normative modeling enables individualized characterization of structural brain deviations by evaluating subjects against a reference population rather than a group average. Most existing implementations treat brain regions independently and remain cross-sectional, despite the availability of repeated neuroimaging measurements and the well-documented spatial organization of neuroanatomical variation.
